name: Streaming Cat Food Communists And The Politics Of Securities Regulation 9565Ab0A57
text: Cat Food Communists and the Politics of Securities Regulation states that SEC v. Ralston Purina requires investor sophistication and access to information for a securities sale to qualify as a private offering. This supplies a judicial eligibility test relevant to Kaal's account of private-placement investor limits. It does not establish that accredited-investor or qualified-purchaser status alone satisfies the test or supplies adequate protection.
